title: Switching this machine from opt to brew for one release warned every estate: the two installs name the release by two commits devbin cannot place, and the update notice speaks even when no vendored file would change
body:
Seen on 2026-11-02, after devbin 0.1.19's sweep. The sweep vendored the frame's 20 estates from the opt install, which was published from the release commit in the workroom, e532a0f67250. hv then ran `brew upgrade devbin` and `devbin use brew`. Homebrew's install of the same release records the release's public snapshot, 0b5e4fa0f540, the commit the public main and the v0.1.19 tag name. The vendored files are identical: the runtime digest is 87bdef24740d under both, and a re-sweep from Homebrew's install found every file level in all 20 estates. In Molt, `bin/devbin --version` still printed:

```
NOTE: the devbin this project came from differs from what it vendored: which way the source moved cannot be told from what is on disk.
      vendored e532a0f67250, source now 0b5e4fa0f540
      it is not known to be newer; run: bin/devbin vendor      (silence: DEVBIN_NO_UPDATE_NOTICE=1)
```

Every estate would have printed it once a day on a terminal until its next upgrade. Two causes, each enough on its own:

1. The two installs of one release name it by different commits, and nothing places one against the other. The opt install's ancestry table carries the workroom's history (2836 lines). Homebrew's carries one line, a9b8cd7c11a9 forward, since the formula builds from the public tag. Neither of Homebrew's records names e532a0f6, so source_direction cannot say which way the source moved.
2. The notice speaks for a direction it cannot establish even when no vendored file would change. devbin_source_state (lib/helpers) asks seam_is_level for a forward move alone, so a forward move that changes no vendored byte reads `moved` and stays quiet (issue 0224). The case where no direction can be established reads `differs`, and _devbin_update_line prints it whatever the bytes.

The same happened the other way while `devbin use brew` ran: Homebrew's install, run while the link still named opt, compared its own record with opt's and printed the NOTE about itself.

Meanwhile, hv ruled on 2026-11-02 that the fleet be re-swept from Homebrew's install, so every estate now records 0b5e4fa0f540: one commit per estate, the manifest alone, at 04:07Z by date -u. A release's sweep run after hv's brew steps distributes Homebrew's install and avoids this.

Done when an estate whose vendored files are level with its source's prints no update notice, whichever commits the two records name, and switching this machine between two installs of one release leaves every estate quiet.

## Resolution

Fixed at b932de553ccc2a06d24d84ef40c6a6f45b76dff5, landed on main by devbin-vc's land-stack.sh from the tested tip 3fa38515, whose paths it equals, unpushed until the 0.1.20 cut. devbin_source_state now asks seam_is_level about every difference that is not a forward move, where it asked about a forward move alone, and a difference that changes no vendored byte reads a new state, matches: the update notice and the upgrade offer stay quiet, and doctor passes while still naming both commits and why they differ. Bytes that cannot be read leave ahead or differs as they were, so it fails closed as 0224's check does. bin/devbin help doctor names the state, and lib/install's note on seam_is_level's callers says the same. updatenotice.bats holds the three differences that read matches (a recorded commit no history places, one the source does not hold, and a source rewound past the project) and the two that still differ (a vendored byte changed, and bytes that cannot be compared). It was proved on its own test, under hv's rule of 2026-11-05 that each fix runs its own test alone, on pplr-vc's desk with the driver's kit read by devbin-vc: in red4-0319 (6ab32eef), the base's code with the unit's updatenotice.bats on top, the three arms that read matches were red as wanted and the two that still differ passed there by construction; at 3fa38515 under BSD, updatenotice (40 of 40), upgradeoffer (21 of 21), doctor (71 of 71) and machinepointer (43 of 43) were green, each file whole. The GNU legs, the tree scans, the critic and the whole suite run once, before the cut.
